small, nearly monodisperse liposome vesicles exhibit enhanced transdermal transport and that the small liposomes pass rapidly and intact through the stratum comeum.
microfluidic synthesis of monodisperse liposome dispersions is used to elucidate the size-dependent transdermal transport properties of lipid vesicles.

the synthesis and applications of microfluidic-generated liposomes, which are used to investigate the transdermal transport and drug delivery of nanoparticles.

the development of microfluidic-based methods for the synthesis of small and monodisperse liposomal nanoparticles for transdermal drug delivery applications.

the size of the liposome is a critical parameter for its ability to penetrate the skin, and the smaller the liposome the better the penetration.
